title: Implement merge sort in Go
description: Greenfield Go task: implement MergeSort(arr []int) []int that returns a new sorted slice using the divide-and-conquer merge sort algorithm.

required_artifacts: Returns new sorted slice (does not sort in-place)
Base case returns a copy for len<=1
Splits at mid and recurses on both halves
merge helper merges two sorted slices into one
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
